capabilities: Insert wiki links to files, headings, and blocks with optional display text
Toggle embed syntax (![[...]]) on any link before insertion
Copy file and heading links from the File Explorer and paste them with configurable options
Create missing Markdown notes directly from the file picker
Configure link-text fallbacks, recent files, and which link types appear in the builder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it performs no network requests, telemetry, or analytics, and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's built-in link insertion is limited to basic wiki links, making it slow to build heading links, block-ID links, links with display text, or embeds.
summary: Keyboard-driven link builder that inserts wiki links to files, headings, and blocks, with display text, embed toggling, and copy-paste support.
